words.gloss: measure word for small round things

lines.trans: Exactly, the red star drawn by the mapmaker professor is right in the dead centre of the second-floor railing!
But the top of the second-floor railing is completely empty; apart from wooden planks, there is absolutely nothing.
Chen, raise your head and look carefully into that patch of shadow right beneath the railing!

lines.trans: Good heavens, there really is a pitch-black round iron ring secured onto the wooden planks!
Is that a hook used for hanging an old brass lantern?

I will go fetch the tall ladder right now—truly unexpected that the secret was above our heads the whole time!
When Manager Zhou comes out wearing his reading glasses and sees it, he will definitely jump in massive surprise!
Let us go, off to the second-floor balcony; together we will take down the thirty-year-old gift!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì zhí. Describes walking straight (一直走) or doing something non-stop.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì qǐ. Placed right before the verb to mean 'together' (一起吃晚饭 'have dinner together').

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
examples.trans: Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最上面 ('the very top').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú guò. Gentle conversational 'though / however', softer than 但是.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng jiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 正中间 ('the exact middle').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 两栋砖房中间是一个安静的小院。
examples.trans: Between the two brick buildings lies a quiet small courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǐ xì. Describes checking details or listening closely.

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

examples.text: 出门前请仔细检查一下门锁。
examples.trans: Please check the door lock carefully before going out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū lái. Directional complement for coming out or figuring something out (认出来).

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì tú yuán. Combines 制图 ('make maps/charts') + occupational suffix 员 ('person/specialist'); measure word: 位 (wèi) or 名 (míng).

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 这位细心的制图员用钢笔在厚纸上画出了整条老街。
examples.trans: This careful mapmaker drew the entire old lane on heavy paper with a fountain pen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Small paper card for notes, gifts, or study.

examples.text: 礼物盒里放着一张小卡片。
examples.trans: Inside the gift box sits a small card.

examples.text: 他在卡片上写了几句祝福。
examples.trans: He wrote a few wishes on the card.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个取。
examples.trans: I have a 取.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的取。
examples.trans: This is a very good 取.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě. Adds emphatic warmth before an adjective/verb, or means 'but'.

examples.text: 我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
examples.trans: I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!

examples.text: 今天外面的风可真大。
examples.trans: The wind outside today is really strong.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu shàng jiǎo. Location noun combining 右 ('right') + 上 ('upper') + 角 ('corner'); takes 在 directly without 里.

examples.text: 四张水彩卡片的右上角，都用蓝墨水标着数字。
examples.trans: In the upper-right corner of all four watercolour cards, numbers are marked in blue ink.

examples.text: 请在明信片的右上角贴好邮票再投进邮筒。
examples.trans: Please stick a stamp on the top-right corner of the postcard before dropping it in the postbox.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used when a sudden noise or surprise startles someone.

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 刚才的响声吓了我一跳。
examples.trans: That noise just now gave me a start.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎ. Combines with a measure word to ask 'which?' (哪个 'which one?', 哪间 'which room?').

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pēn quán. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座喷泉 ('a fountain').

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

examples.text: 小广场中间有一座石头喷泉。
examples.trans: There is a stone fountain in the middle of the small plaza.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì. Cardinal number 4.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个固定。
examples.trans: I have a 固定.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的固定。
examples.trans: This is a very good 固定.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán. Describes round tables, seals, or shapes.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 院子中间有一张圆木桌。
examples.trans: There is a round wooden table in the middle of the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì tú. Combines 地 ('earth/land') + 图 ('chart/drawing'); measure word: 张 (zhāng) or 幅 (fú).

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 小晴在手绘地图上用红笔标出了过桥以后的绿药店。
examples.trans: On the hand-drawn map, Qing marked the green pharmacy past the bridge in red pen.

块.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

meanings.en: measure word for pieces and yuan
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. Counts chunks/pieces (一块蛋糕 'a piece of cake') and spoken yuan of money (五块钱 'five yuan').

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一整天 ('a whole day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

meanings.note: Locative noun tóudǐng ('above one's head').

examples.text: 头顶上一直悬着一把剑。
examples.trans: A sword has been hanging right overhead all along.

examples.text: 头顶的追光灯突然亮了起来。
examples.trans: The spotlight overhead suddenly lit up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo chī. Literally 'good to eat'; contrast 好喝 for drinks.

examples.text: 小晴，炒蛋真好吃，替我夸夸小美！
examples.trans: The scrambled eggs are delicious, Qing. Tell Mei my compliments!

examples.text: 小美烤的肉桂卷真好吃！
examples.trans: The cinnamon rolls Mei bakes are delicious!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū gu. Specifically father's sister (second syllable neutral tone); distinct from 阿姨 / 姨妈 (mother's sister).

examples.text: 周经理的姑姑以前也住在这座老院子里。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's paternal aunt used to live in this old courtyard too.

examples.text: 我姑姑年轻的时候最喜欢弹钢琴。
examples.trans: When my aunt was young, she loved playing the piano most of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè zhàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家客栈 ('an inn').

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 我们客栈都是五星级服务……哎呀！
examples.trans: At our inn, everything is five-star service... whoops!

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Means 'correct!' on its own, 'right' as a result complement (拿对), or 'to/toward' before a noun.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.en: want to; would like to; think; miss
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Before a verb, expresses a polite wish ('would like to'); before a noun/person, 'think of / miss'.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng. Frequently serves as a result complement meaning 'into' (变成, 改成).

examples.text: 商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
examples.trans: Commercial office sale?! Turn our inn and kitchen into grey offices?!

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài. Specifically for accessories placed on the head, face, neck, or wrist—contrast 穿 for clothes/shoes.

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái tóu. Separable verb-object compound; opposite of 低头.

examples.text: 高个子，深灰色外套，正抬头看我们客栈招牌呢！
examples.trans: Tall, dark grey coat, looking up at our inn sign right now!

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Colloquial predicate pīn ('pushing oneself to the limit').

examples.text: 你太拼了！
examples.trans: You are pushing yourself way too hard!

examples.text: 为了节目大家都很拼。
examples.trans: Everyone goes all-out for the show.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà. Used for hanging keys, coats, lanterns, or hanging up a phone.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Used for pointing toward a sign, map, or clue (指着).

examples.text: 谁也没走开！志豪正指着那两把椅子呢！
examples.trans: Neither of them walked away! Hao is pointing at those two chairs right now!

examples.text: 周经理，快看志豪先生用铅笔指的地方！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, look where Mr Zhihao is pointing with his pencil!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān. Used for moving furniture, boxes, or moving house.

examples.text: 四个纸箱五分钟就能搬走。现在就上去看！
examples.trans: We can move four boxes in five minutes. Let's go up and look right now!

examples.text: 请帮我把这张桌子搬到院子里。
examples.trans: Please help me move this table out to the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pronounced jiàoshòu; placed after a surname when used as a form of address (e.g., 方教授 'Professor Fang').
Pronounced jiàoshòu (or jiāoshòu in older usage) as a formal transitive verb meaning 'to impart knowledge or skills'.

examples.text: 我想问一下，方教授在哪办公啊？
examples.trans: May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?

examples.text: 小谷同学，先来认识一下学位评委的各位教授。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, come meet the professors on the degree committee first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Describes old houses, pipes, or letters—never a person's age (use 老 for people).

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng xing. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗星星 ('a star'). Neutral tone on the second syllable in spoken Mandarin.

examples.text: 黄铜盖子里面刻着一颗小星星和名字缩写。
examples.trans: Engraved inside the brass cover is a tiny star beside initials.

examples.text: 晴朗的夏夜，站在小院阳台上能看见满天星星。
examples.trans: On a clear summer night, you can see a sky full of stars from the courtyard balcony.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù bǎn. Combines 木 ('wood') + 板 ('board/plank'); measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 这块木板在我手里十五年，一直只有一到八号挂钩。
examples.trans: For fifteen years in my hands, this wooden board only ever held hooks one through eight.

examples.text: 老陈挑了两块干燥的厚木板来做新书架。
examples.trans: Chen picked out two thick dry wooden boards to build the new bookshelf.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng rén. Combines 杏 ('apricot/almond') + 仁 ('nut kernel').

examples.text: 小美端来了一盘刚出炉的温热杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: Mei brought over a plate of warm almond biscuits fresh from the oven.

examples.text: 用杏仁粉做的柠檬挞底吃起来特别香酥。
examples.trans: A lemon tart crust made with ground almonds tastes wonderfully crisp and nutty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个栏杆 ('a 栏杆').

examples.text: 我有一个栏杆。
examples.trans: I have a 栏杆.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的栏杆。
examples.trans: This is a very good 栏杆.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tī zi. Second syllable neutral tone. Measure word: 把 (bǎ) or 架 (jià).

examples.text: 老陈站在木梯子上换天花板顶灯的电线。
examples.trans: Chen stood on the wooden stepladder replacing the wires for the ceiling lamp.

examples.text: 爬梯子的时候，下面最好有人帮忙扶着。
examples.trans: When climbing a ladder, it is best to have someone steady it from below.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋楼 ('a building').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ cǎi. Literally 'water-colour'; 水彩画 ('watercolour painting'), 水彩卡片 ('watercolour card').

examples.text: 厚棉纸上画着四幅精致的水彩街景小画。
examples.trans: Four delicate little watercolour street sketches are painted on the heavy cotton paper.

examples.text: 雨水把蓝墨水晕开了，看起来倒像一幅水彩画！
examples.trans: Rainwater blurred the blue ink until it actually looked like a watercolour painting!

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi cuò. Enthusiastic agreement ('Spot on! / Exactly!').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng long. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯笼 ('a lantern').

examples.text: 老陈，你在为中午挂纸灯笼吗？
examples.trans: Chen, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adv used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个用来。
examples.trans: I have a 用来.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的用来。
examples.trans: This is a very good 用来.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Used for drawing blueprints or painting signs.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn jiàn. Result compound: 看 ('look') + 见 ('perceive') = 'actually see'.

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn de. Used standalone ('Really?!' 真的吗？！) or before verbs as an emphatic adverb.

examples.text: 真的吗？！你真的把火车票改到星期六早上了？
examples.trans: Really?! Did you really move your train ticket to Saturday morning?

examples.text: 加了杏仁粉的柠檬挞真的特别香！
examples.trans: The lemon tart made with almond flour is truly fragrant!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个礼物 ('a 礼物').

examples.text: 我有一个礼物。
examples.trans: I have a 礼物.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的礼物。
examples.trans: This is a very good 礼物.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mì mì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个秘密 ('a secret').

examples.text: 真的吗？我厨房的墙后面真的有一个秘密房间？
examples.trans: Is it true? Is there really a secret room behind my kitchen wall?

examples.text: 这是我们两个人的秘密。
examples.trans: This is a secret between the two of us.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个空空。
examples.trans: I have a 空空.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的空空。
examples.trans: This is a very good 空空.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng. Everyday verb for waiting (等一下 'wait a moment').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng. Describes the color red; note that 红茶 is what English calls 'black tea'.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo huā jìng. Combines 老花 ('presbyopia / farsightedness of middle age') + 镜 ('glasses/lenses'); measure word: 副 (fù).

examples.text: 周经理摸了摸额头问：“等等——我的老花镜现在是不是又架在额头上？”
examples.trans: Manager Zhou felt his forehead and asked, 'Wait—are my reading glasses perched up on my forehead again right now?'

examples.text: 老陈看细小的钢琴零件时，总会从口袋里拿出那副老花镜戴上。
examples.trans: Whenever Chen inspects tiny piano parts, he takes that pair of reading glasses out of his pocket and puts them on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kěn dìng. Colloquial cousin of 一定 for confident predictions.

examples.text: 箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
examples.trans: The suitcase's owner will surely come looking for it soon.

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi guǒ. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē) or 篮 (lán). Joins 莓 ('berry') + 果 ('fruit').

examples.text: 小美在蛋糕顶上点缀了几颗新鲜的红莓果。
examples.trans: Mei garnished the top of the cake with a few fresh red berries.

examples.text: 这罐果酱是用后院刚摘的野莓果熬制的。
examples.trans: This jar of jam was simmered from wild berries just picked in the backyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cáng. Read cáng for 'hide'; often followed by 在 + place (藏在走廊里 'hidden in the hallway').

examples.text: 一扇真的门，就藏在走廊里！
examples.trans: A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!

examples.text: 小猫藏在桌子下面。
examples.trans: The kitten is hiding under the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn gāo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块蛋糕 ('a piece of cake').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
examples.trans: Eleven twenty. Mei, is the cake ready?

related.gloss: a piece of cake (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiào. Describes jumping or a racing heartbeat (心跳得好快).

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nàr. Spoken variant of 那里 ('there').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个钩子 ('a 钩子').

examples.text: 我有一个钩子。
examples.trans: I have a 钩子.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的钩子。
examples.trans: This is a very good 钩子.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Marks an exception or addition.

examples.text: 除了他以外，办公室里其他人都下班了。
examples.trans: Apart from him, everyone else in the office has gone home.

examples.text: 这件事除了好朋友，我谁也没告诉。
examples.trans: Besides my close friend, I told nobody about this.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一面 ('one side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 墙上挂着一面干净的大镜子。
examples.trans: A clean large mirror hangs on the wall.

颗.gloss: measure word for small round things

meanings.en: measure word for small round things
meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Counts stars, pearls, beans, buttons, and hearts (一颗星 'a star').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 小盘子里放着五颗新鲜草莓。
examples.trans: Five fresh strawberries sit on the small plate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo. Describes tall people, high ceilings, or high scores.

examples.text: 让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
examples.trans: Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng tóng. Literally 黄 ('yellow/golden') + 铜 ('copper/bronze'): copper-zinc brass alloy.

examples.text: 钢琴琴槌里面的细小轴销是用结实的黄铜做的。
examples.trans: The tiny hinge pins inside piano hammers are made of sturdy brass.

examples.text: 老陈把前台的黄铜小铃铛擦得金光发亮。
examples.trans: Chen polished the little brass bell on the front desk until it gleamed.
